query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

content.text:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

🎉 **So long, Stephen — you magnificent meme machine!** 🎉

They say the best engineers don't just fix problems — they make everyone laugh while doing it. You, Stephen, mastered BOTH. 🛠️😂

From debugging code to dropping the perfect meme at the perfect moment, you've made this place smarter, funnier, and a whole lot more bearable on Monday mornings. 📅💻

As you ride off into your next adventure, just remember: the world is your pull request, and we know you'll merge it flawlessly. 🚀

We'll miss your genius, your wit, and honestly... your memes more than you'll ever know. The group chat will never be the same. 😢📱

Go out there and **build something legendary** — and don't forget to send us a meme or two along the way! 😄

**Best of luck, Stephen. You were one of a kind. The bar has been set HIGH! 🌟**

— Your forever fans at [Company Name] ❤️

---

Feel free to customize it with any inside jokes or specific memories to make it even more personal! 🎊
